newsitem.title: UK: S&P rates Global Ocean Carriers B plus.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Global Ocean Carriers B plus.

text.p: Standard & Poor's has assigned its B plus corporate credit rating to Greece-based Global Ocean Carriers Ltd and rated the company's dollar senior unsecured notes at B plus, the rating agency said on Friday.
"The corporate credit rating reflects Global Ocean's position as an efficient operator in the dry bulk and feeder container shipping industry," S&P said.
"The ratings are held back by the dry bulk and feeder container shipping industries' worse-than-average industry characteristics and a very aggressive capital structure," the rating agency added.
The outlook is stable, Standard & Poor's said.
"Standard & Poor's anticipates balance sheet improvement in the short- to medium-term as cash flow and future share issues are expected to more than offset further fleet expansion."
